# Spider_XHS upstream snapshot

- Repository: https://github.com/cv-cat/Spider_XHS
- Commit: `9504b5249103f34a0a4e7062939258061559e2fd`
- Commit date: 2026-07-19

The files under `apis/`, `xhs_utils/`, and `static/` are copied without
modification from that commit. Only the PC search API, PC login API, and their
direct signing/runtime dependencies are included.

The upstream repository does not contain a LICENSE file. Its README states
that the project is for learning and communication and prohibits commercial
use. Do not redistribute or use this snapshot commercially without permission
from the upstream author.
